---
description: item_merge as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
doing: merging two records of one thing
arguments:
  keep: "The record that stays."
  drop: "The record that goes: the same thing recorded twice."
  source: "Where it comes from: from is prose, lore, author, gm, character, player, default or invented; lore, message and roll cite an entry, a message or a roll by id; an invention cites its gap_check and consent."
  precision: "How exact: exact, approximate, vague or unknown."
  standing: "How it stands: established, proposed or assumed."
---
Merges two records of one thing into one: the count, the leave to use it and what is inside the dropped record go to the kept one, and the dropped one leaves the world. The answer says what changed; given as a receipt, it leaves how the kept one now stands to the file it names.
